name: macos-glass
summary: macOS vibrancy: translucent chrome over the sidebar material
body:
The window now carries the NSVisualEffectView sidebar material;
the rail, sidebar, titlebar and statusbar go translucent so the
desktop blurs through (Fork's frosted look) while content panes stay
opaque for readability. nativeTheme follows the in-app theme so the
glass matches a forced light/dark; non-mac platforms keep solid
colors (preload exposes the platform for the renderer to decide).
